events.name: Bug Collector
events.description: You run into a bug collector. He offers to share with you one of the bugs he has caught today.

events.name: Dragons Nest
events.description: You stumble upon a dragon's hoard. Take something before the dragon comes back!

events.name: Rainbow Berry
events.description: As you wade through the forest, you stumble upon a berry bush. In the bush is a peculiar rainbow berry.

events.name: Baby Basilisk
events.description: In the middle of a forest, you come across a crying baby basilisk monster. It seems it has gotten lost from its parents.

events.name: Meteor Crash
events.description: You see a meteor fly through the sky and then crash nearby. You rush over to see the meteor with a glowing gem embed in it.

options.flavor: Take some meteor debris and sell it

events.name: Pond Fairy
events.description: As you stroll through the forest, a blue fairy monster emerges from a nearby pond. The fairy says it will grant you a wish.

events.name: Dragon Tamer
events.description: You run into a traveling dragon tamer. He says he has too many dragons to take care of and offers you to adopt one.

options.flavor: Adopt the one with the big horn
Adopt the one with the crown

events.name: Dryad Statue
events.description: You explore deep into the woods and find a statue with a glowing gem embedded in its head.

options.reward: Give a monster Grass typing, Gain a Dryadell

events.name: Genius Inventor
events.description: You encounter a genius inventor. He asks if you want to test any of his new inventions.

options.reward: Give a monster Electric typing and +5 Shock

events.name: Professor Encounter
events.description: You run into a monster professor who's out doing research. He asks if there is anything you need help with?
